blocks.content: Given a text that contains several words. Use a HashMap to count the number of words in the given text.

text = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
output = {the=2, over=1, quick=1, lazy=1, jumps=1, brown=1, dog=1, fox=1}

text = "I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream!"
output = {all=1, for=1, I=1, scream=1, ice=1, cream!=1, you=1, we=1, scream,=2}

text = it was an amazing amazing amazing day
output = {amazing=3, was=1, it=1, an=1, day=1}
